metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Cowley's visit, the roll and the broth from the bed, and the line written back.

yesterday: Cowley took Egeon. The current word is Ephesus at the third speech.
Mistress Ansell set bread and broth down and kept him to the chair.
Errors played at two. You could not hear it from the bed.
You struck a line and wrote it back.
The fever was highest in the evening. You stayed in.
